root_cause.text: Missing cleanup of dequeued queue entry when nfqa_parse_bridge() fails in nfqnl_recv_verdict(), causing the function to return without freeing the nf_queue_entry and its associated sk_buff after taking ownership via find_dequeue_entry().
root_cause.evidence: The patch shows that nfqnl_recv_verdict() calls find_dequeue_entry() to remove and take ownership of the queue entry, then calls nfqa_parse_bridge() for PF_BRIDGE packets. When nfqa_parse_bridge() returns an error, the original code immediately returns without invoking nfqnl_reinject() to properly drop and free the entry. The fix adds `nfqnl_reinject(entry, NF_DROP)` before the error return, ensuring the dequeued entry is properly cleaned up rather than leaked.
